# commercetools_integration_layer_session_defaults (Resource)

The language, currency and country a new shopper session on the Commerce Integration Layer starts with, and the label the Project is shown with. A storefront can choose others for a session; these apply when it does not.

They are picked from what the commercetools Project offers, which `commercetools_project_settings` defines, and spelled as the Project spells them (`DE`, not `de`). The API stores any value and a wrong one only fails once a session uses it, so the provider checks them before writing.

The Project has to be enrolled in the Commerce Integration Layer already, and the API client needs the `manage_project` scope. A Project has one set of session defaults, so define this resource once per Project. They cannot be removed: destroying the resource only removes it from the state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commercetools_integration_layer_session_defaults" "defaults" {
  label    = "My Shop"
  language = "nl-NL"
  currency = "EUR"
  country  = "NL"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `country` (String) Country a session starts with, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code the Project offers, such as `DE`.
- `currency` (String) Currency a session starts with, as an ISO 4217 code the Project offers, such as `EUR`.
- `label` (String) Display name of the Project on the Commerce Integration Layer.
- `language` (String) Language a session starts with, as a BCP 47 tag the Project offers, such as `en-US`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The key of the Project the defaults belong to.
- `region_id` (String) Region the Commerce Integration Layer serves the Project from. Set by commercetools.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The session defaults are a singleton per Project, so they are imported
# using the Project key.
terraform import commercetools_integration_layer_session_defaults.defaults my-project-key
```
